title: lupinus lepidus subsp. lyallii
intro: Lupinus lepidus subsp. lyallii, commonly known as Lyall's lupine, is a rare and threatened species of lupine, a flowering plant in the legume family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lyall's lupine include reducing pain, inflammation, and fever, as well as exhibiting antiseptic and antiviral properties. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
